svg.text: Placement and wiring — Buffered Prototype Board V3.0a + DOIT ESP32 DevKit V1; 74LS373 write latch
• U23 74LS373: VCC 20 = +5 V; /OE 1 = GND; LE 11 from U24.8.
• D0–D7 = P54.1–8; Q0–Q7 = U20 A0–A7; 10K pull-downs on D.
• U24 pin 7 GND, pin 14 +5 V; tie the unused gate inputs.
• LVC245: VCC 20 = 3.3 V only; DIR 1 = 3V3; /OE 19 = GND.
• U20: A0–A7 = U23 Q; B0–B7 = ESP32. U21 A0–A3 = controls.
• Never fit an LVC245 in the board's 5 V buffer sockets.
• 10K pull-downs on P54.1–8. GPIO5 10K up at H10; GPIO12 10K down at L1.
• A0 mod: U110.17 cut → GND; JP4 fit. Fit JP11,8,7,6,5.
• 682 Q1/Q2 (A6/A5) high: leave JP10, JP9 open.
• The 7406 is the only VI5 driver; keep VI5 low until claimed.
• Module: antenna up (board top edge), USB down; check silkscreen.
P7 ESP32 module, columns 1 and 10, rows A–O.
P14 U23 74LS373 rows B–E; U20 LVC rows G–J; U21 LVC rows K–N.
P10 U24 74LS00 rows B–E; U22 7406 rows G–J.
Headers: P54 DO, P50 DI, P44 sOUT/sINP, P47 SEL, P40 A0.
